name: 何承運
objective:
本課程探討邊緣運算（Edge Computing）於現代分散式系統與智慧網路中的核心角色，強調從傳統雲端架構轉向「雲–邊–端協同（Cloud–Edge–Device Continuum）」之設計思維。課程內容涵蓋邊緣架構設計、資源配置與任務卸載（offloading）、邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）、以及與 5G/6G 通訊系統之整合。此外，課程將深入探討低延遲應用（如智慧製造、AR/VR、自駕車）、邊緣資料分析、隱私保護與安全機制，並介紹容器化（containerization）、微服務（microservices）與邊緣原生（edge-native）系統設計。透過論文文獻研讀與專題實作，使學生具備設計與實現新世代邊緣智慧系統之能力。
This course explores the principles and emerging trends of edge computing in modern distributed and intelligent network systems. It focuses on the paradigm shift from centralized cloud computing to the Cloud–Edge–Device continuum, enabling low-latency, real-time, and context-aware services. Topics include edge architecture design, resource management, task offloading, edge AI, federated learning, and integration with 5G/6G networks. The course also covers edge analytics, security and privacy, and cloud-native technologies such as containers and microservices. Students will engage in paper reading and hands-on projects to develop advanced edge-enabled intelligent systems.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1	Introduction to Edge Computing and Emerging Applications
Week 2	Cloud–Edge–Device Continuum Architecture
Week 3	Containerization and Edge Computing Platforms
Week 4	Resource Management and Service Deployment
Week 5	SDN and NFV Technologies
Week 6	Intelligent Networking and Traffic Management
Week 7	Research Topics, Literature Search, and Paper Reading
Week 8	Project Proposal Presentation
Week 9	Edge AI and Model Deployment
Week 10	Task Offloading and Computation Migration
Week 11	Federated Learning and Distributed Intelligence
Week 12	Security and Privacy in Edge Computing
Week 13	5G/6G and Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC)
Week 14	Emerging Trends in Edge Intelligence and Paper Review
Week 15	Final Project Presentation and Research Report (I)
Week 16	Final Project Presentation and Research Report (II)
Week 17 (Flexible Learning) Independent Paper Study and Literature Review Report
Week 18 (Flexible Learning) Research Presentation, Reflection, and Future Research Planning
